title: PEAK — adaptive trailing stop
description: A trailing stop that follows the high-water mark and tightens when a move looks exhausted. Arming replaces any existing protective stop on the position.

trailWidePct.title: Wide trail (%)
trailWidePct.description: The leash while simply riding. The stop sits this far below the highest price seen since the order was placed, and follows it up. Alpaca refuses anything under 0.1% (measured, 2026-08-12).

trailTightPct.title: Tight trail (%)
trailTightPct.description: Trail width after a blow-off is detected. Tighter than the wide trail, on the view that an exhausted move gives back fast.

extPctThreshold.title: Blow-off: extension above the 20-day average (%)
extPctThreshold.description: How far above the moving average counts as extended. One of two conditions that must both hold before the trail tightens.

slopePctThreshold.title: Blow-off: vertical move (%)
slopePctThreshold.description: A move of this size over the last few 1-minute bars also counts as a blow-off, so a fast spike is caught even before it is stretched far from the base. Either condition is enough.

offHodPctThreshold.title: Fade: distance off the high (%)
offHodPctThreshold.description: How far off the session high counts as fading. Pairs with the extension threshold; both must hold.

lowerHighBars.title: Fade: consecutive lower highs
lowerHighBars.description: Consecutive lower highs required to confirm a fade. Fewer fires on noise; more can miss the turn.

trimMax.title: Maximum trims
trimMax.description: Maximum trims per trade cycle. Bounds transaction cost — a re-arm inherits what the cycle already spent.

trimFraction.title: Trim size (fraction of the position)
trimFraction.description: How much of what is currently held gets sold on each trim. 0.45 = 45%. Deliberately chunky rather than repeated small nibbles, which would pay the spread over and over.

trailWideAtrMultiple.title: Wide trail (x ATR)
trailWideAtrMultiple.description: Normal trail width, in ATRs. Scaled per symbol rather than a flat percentage, because one percentage cannot fit a book whose ATR ranges from 1.6% to 11.2%.

trailTightAtrMultiple.title: Tight trail (x ATR)
trailTightAtrMultiple.description: The tightened trail after a blowoff, also in ATRs. Must stay below the wide multiple or the blowoff branch would WIDEN the stop instead of tightening it — the one thing it exists to do.

atrLookback.title: ATR lookback (days)
atrLookback.description: Sessions of true range averaged to measure the symbol's normal daily movement. Matches the protection domain's own lookback so both stops on one instrument are sized off the same number.
